links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified NHS hospital TMD patient information
links.outcome: Readability of TMD patient information (FKGL, GFI, CLI and FRES) against a sixth-grade target
links.effect: Originals: 12/31 met target by FKGL and 1/31 by GFI/CLI, mean FRES 64.68 (6.79). After Gemini: 96.8% met target by FKGL, 54.8% by GFI, 29.0% by CLI, mean FRES 82.59 (5.73) (p < 0.001).
links.tradeoff: Improvement depended on the readability tool: only 29.0% met the target by CLI and 54.8% by GFI after Gemini. Accuracy and completeness of the rewritten text are not reported in the abstract.
links.quote: Gemini improved the mean (SD) score significantly to 82.59 (5.73) (p < 0.001) for FRES, meeting the target readability level.

design_hint: reading-level constraint on LLM-revised patient materials
